newsitem.title: UK: Luminar up on upbeat press comment.
newsitem.headline: Luminar up on upbeat press comment.

text.p: Shares in cafe owner Luminar Plc rose on Tuesday after upbeat comment on the stock in the Sunday Times' Insight Track column, dealers said.
Luminar, owner of the Chicago Rock Cafe group, was quoted up 10p at 387-1/2 by 1005 GMT in thin volume of 34,661 shares.

The Sunday Times said the shares "continue to look good value for the medium-term investor," saying the company was developing a strong brand which should ensure a smooth expansion path -- and that it could also be a takeover target for one of the larger brewers.
